en:
It's the <CLT=cltSTRONG>inner tube<CLT=cltNORMAL>! The rubber inner tube
we found floating in the pool!
The inner tube?

Remember the inner tube we found in the
pool, with the rope on one side?

Maybe the rope was originally
tied on both sides.

The culprit made a ropeway by hanging the
tube from the rope connecting the windows.

And because the 3rd floor window is higher up,
gravity would have pushed the inner tube along.

The inner tube is made of sturdy rubber
as well. It could have supported two people.

The culprit used the ropes and the inner
tube to construct a rudimentary ropeway...

and used it to move themselves and
Ryoma's body from the lab to the gym.

Once through the gym window, the culprit
stood on the inner tube to move the body.

Either that, or the culprit placed
their foot on the windowsill.

That way would be more stable and
let them handle the corpse more carefully.

Finally, they removed the rope from
the window frame and left the scene.

Well... When you put it like that,
it certainly sounds possible...
But, wow! A ropeway!

You say the culprit placed their foot on the 
windowsill? Isn't that <CLT=cltSTRONG>against school rules<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

It would count as entering the gym,
would it not?

Last time we got asked that question, we
decided it was <CLT=cltSTRONG>okay<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Stickin' your body through the window is an
automatic out, but standing on the sill is—
Wait, who asked you last time?

It is quite possible that the culprit went to
you to confirm the details of their plan...
...O-Oh shiiiiit!
Way to put your foot in your mouth.

His foot!? Monosuke just unhinged his jaw
and swallowed his entire leg!

C-Cut it out! I can't write this off as a joke
if you two keep freakin' out about it!

Nyahahahahaha! Then your little slip-up
is actually the truth!
P-Pops?
Uh-oh... Daddy's mad at you now.
...Huh?

Don't look at me. This is what you get
for acting like a bigshot all the time.
STOP... DO-NOT-BULLY-MONOSUKE.
...Huh?

NO-MORE-BLAMING-EACH-OTHER.
EVERYBODY-MAKES-MISTAKES.
I-WANT-US-ALL-TO-GET-ALONG.
Monodam's right.

Monosuke, you better thank Monodam!
Less attitude and more gratitude, got it!?

Maaan, the trial was just getting fun.
Why you gotta ruin it with that slip-up?

But I guess now we know Shuichi's logic
is right on the money.

So culprit really used ropeway
to move body!?

Yeah, they used the ropeway to move 
with the body from window to window.

Ropeway murder...!
That's some crazy-ass shit!

But if the mechanism was that complicated,
wouldn't it be hard to put it all away?
Not necessarily.

All one must do is detach the rope from 
the window after using the ropeway.

Then, after returning to Ryoma's lab,
one could retrieve the rope from that side.

Tossing the rope into the gym from 
the pool window would be the final step.

I see, I see! The rope was thrown from the
window. That's why we found it there.

With that method, the culprit must have made 
numerous trips from Ryoma's lab to the pool...

Which is why the crime was committed 
during nighttime, while we all slumbered.

But if the culprit was so careful to recover
the rope they used to commit the crime...

Why did they leave the inner tube
in the pool?

I believe that was
an accident.
An accident?

Yes. When the culprit was taking down
the inner tube, they accidentally dropped it.

Then why did the culprit leave it in the
pool?

<CLT=cltMIND>The reason the culprit left it
in the pool is obvious...
They don't like water

The culprit doesn't
know how to swim!

We still don't know who the culprit is,
so don't just spout off random shit!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
There was no time

The culprit didn't have enough
time to collect the inner tube!

The crime took place during nighttime!
Of course they had enough time!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
It was nighttime
They didn't notice it

They didn't notice that they
dropped the inner tube!

Your logic is specious. How could the
culprit not notice such a thing...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

There is no way our meticulous culprit
would have left that inner tube behind...
Perhaps your reasoning is flawed?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>The reason the culprit left it
in the pool is obvious...

Even if they wanted to get it, they couldn't.
Because this took place at <CLT=cltSTRONG>nighttime<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

I see, they couldn't get the inner tube because
<CLT=cltSTRONG>swimming is prohibited<CLT=cltNORMAL> at nighttime.

But couldn't they have used the rope
to fish it out?

Not necessarily... You see, the 
water level in that pool is so low...

Even if one tried to draw in the 
inner tube using the rope...

The steep angle the rope would be at
would make it nigh impossible.

It'd be different if they used a pole,
but there's no way a rope would work.

Even if inner tube was closer to pool edge,
water still too low to drag tube in.

Sounds like a lotta work...
I can see why they just left it there.

Yeah, it would take too long. And they
would've been busted if someone saw them.

Hah! What kinda clumsy dipshit drops an
inner tube and can't retrieve it!?

Lemme tell ya, this culprit's a real
fuckin' amateur!

No, actually. Save for that one mistake,
this was the perfect crime.

If Maki had never met up with Ryoma at
nighttime, it might've been the end for us.

Well, I still don't know if Maki is telling the
truth or not...
...Shut up.

Personally, I find this culprit
frighteningly thorough.

Such a bold, beautiful plan! I never 
even imagined there was a ropeway!

Aaah! Respect begins to bloom in my 
heart for this wonderfully cruel culprit.

What are you, stupid!?
Don't respect the culprit!

<CLT=cltMIND>No, respecting the culprit's intelligence
is crucial in solving this case...

<CLT=cltMIND>We're so close...
We're just one step away from the truth...

Now, we just need to figure out who the
culprit is!

But, of course. It would be pointless to
unravel this mystery otherwise.
So, who is it?

Hmph. Looks like it's time for me
to start the main event...

...but my sidekick here's on a roll
right now, so I'll let him take this one.
Hm? Ah, okay.

You're just pushing everything onto Shuichi,
because you don't know yourself.

Well, Shuichi? Do you already know 
who the culprit is?

<CLT=cltMIND>Yes...I have a good
idea of who the culprit is...

Hey, Shuichi.
Are you hesitating again?
<CLT=cltMIND>What?

C'mon, man. There's no need for that.
Like I said, you're my sidekick.

I take responsibility for any 
mistakes my sidekick makes.

So use those skills of yours I believe in...
to shove the truth down their throats!
You...believe in my detective skills?

That's right! I'm gonna leave it all
to you, Shuichi!

<CLT=cltMIND>Yeah...I need to believe in
my detective work...

<CLT=cltMIND>This whole setup would've had to been
prepared in the gym well beforehand...

<CLT=cltMIND>Knowing that narrows
the list of suspects.

<CLT=cltMIND>It wasn't Kaito...but I remember
someone mentioning they went to the gym.

What's the matter?
Just show 'em the logic you believe in!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Kokichi...you did it, didn't you?

Nuh-uh! Between Kirumi and Miu's testimonies,
my alibi is pretty solid.

But if you ask me, I think the person who went
to the gym is suspicious.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>...No, I decided
to trust Maki.

<CLT=cltMIND>I know that someone gave a
statement about visiting the gym...

So, who's the culprit!?
Well, Shuichi!?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

...You silence speaks volumes. I suspect you
do not know the answer either, Shuichi.

Don't worry about it, Shuichi!
I'll take responsibility! Just tell 'em!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Uh-oh! Is something wrong?

Remember everyone's alibis. Do you think that 
person really made the mechanism in the gym?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Who is the culprit?

There's one more thing I still have to
confirm...but <CLT=cltSTRONG>Kirumi<CLT=cltNORMAL> is the prime suspect.
Wh-What!? K-Kirumi!?
Ohhhh... So Kirumi is the culprit.

That is not yet a certainty.
Let us hear her testimony first.
Is this true, Kirumi?
I cannot believe you would suspect me...

If that is the case, then I will have to deny it.
I will not let you make the wrong choice.
...The wrong choice?

If you do believe it is me, are you prepared
to stand by that decision?

I will refute your accusations with all my 
might...for everyone's sake.
